entities.summary: Jorge Marcelo Faurie is an Argentine diplomat, and was Minister of Foreign Affairs and Worship of Argentina, serving in President Mauricio Macri's cabinet from 12 June 2017 to 10 December 2019. He is currently serving as the Argentine Ambassador to Chile since 22 January 2024.
